title: reference-impl: SKILL and prompt updates — verdict writes in security-review skill, refusal-and-recover prose in run skill, verdict in security-reviewer return contract
definition_of_done: reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-security-review/SKILL.md: each terminal branch (pass / bounce / escalate) emits two commits — first `cloverleaf-cli set-task-field <repo_root> <TASK-ID> security_review_verdict <pass|bounce|escalate>` followed by a focused commit, THEN `cloverleaf-cli advance-status <repo_root> <TASK-ID> <automated-gates|implementing|escalated> agent` followed by a focused commit. Verdict-write commit message form: `cloverleaf: <TASK-ID> security_review_verdict → <verdict>`.

reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run/SKILL.md: 'Security gate (both lanes)' section retains the explicit happy-path prose steering high-security tasks through security-review first (belt-and-suspenders). The under-classification writeback prose is simplified — the orchestrator can proactively run classify-security but the writeback is now mechanical and need not be scripted.

reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run/SKILL.md: gains a new 'Refusal and recover' subsection inside the security-gate section describing the v0.8.1 behavior — exit code 2 with a security-gate refusal means the task is high-security with no pass verdict; recovery is `advance-status security-review`, `/cloverleaf-security-review <TASK-ID>`, then retry the original advance.

reference-impl/prompts/security-reviewer.md: 'Return contract' / 'Response envelope' section explicitly requires a top-level `verdict` field on the response envelope, enum {'pass','bounce','escalate'}, derived from the maximum severity across findings per the canonical mapping (blocker→escalate, error|warning→bounce, info|none→pass).

reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts: new coverage on the security-review SKILL — each branch text contains `set-task-field … security_review_verdict <verdict>` followed (in the same code block ordering) by `advance-status … <target-state>`; and new coverage on the cloverleaf-run SKILL — content matches /exit(s)? code 2/i, /security-gate refusal/i, /advance to.*security-review.*first/i, and retains the 'Security gate (both lanes)' header and the `cloverleaf-security-review` reference.
reference-impl/tests/prompts.test.ts: new coverage on security-reviewer.md — content matches /verdict[\s\S]*pass[\s\S]*bounce[\s\S]*escalate/i.
Full reference-impl unit suite passes (`cd reference-impl && npm test`) — no regressions; ~6 new SKILL/prompt tests.
acceptance_criteria: grep `set-task-field` reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-security-review/SKILL.md returns at least three matches (one per terminal branch).

Each terminal-branch code block in cloverleaf-security-review/SKILL.md shows the set-task-field invocation BEFORE the advance-status invocation; the commit message between them references `security_review_verdict → <verdict>`.

grep `Refusal and recover` reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run/SKILL.md returns at least one match; the surrounding paragraph references exit code 2 and the recovery sequence (advance to security-review → /cloverleaf-security-review → retry).
reference-impl/prompts/security-reviewer.md contains a section header or top-level paragraph that names `verdict` as a required envelope field and enumerates 'pass', 'bounce', and 'escalate'.
reference-impl/skills/cloverleaf-run/SKILL.md still contains a 'Security gate (both lanes)' header (belt-and-suspenders prose is preserved, not removed).
